legacy_root.question: In replication research, what structural conditions make a reproduction independent (different team, different tooling, blind to the original conclusion), and which of those conditions can a same-vendor fresh-context agent actually satisfy?
legacy_root.canonical_mechanism: Independence is a bundle of structural conditions (different team, different measuring system / independently developed artifacts, blindness to the original conclusion, and — for replicability rather than reproducibility — new data). A same-vendor fresh-context agent satisfies the context-reset condition and at most a narrow 'no author email' condition. It does not satisfy different-team or different-weights, which are cross-vendor-only. Treating the fresh context as a second signal is one signal, not two.

answer.summary: Eight structural conditions were scored. Same-vendor fresh-context SATISFIES C-CONTEXT, is PARTIAL on C-AUTHOR, and is NOT-SATISFIED on C-TEAM, C-WEIGHTS, C-TOOL, C-BLIND, C-DATA, and C-PREREG. Cross-vendor-only conditions named: C-TEAM and C-WEIGHTS.
answer.uncomfortable_case: A fresh-context agent of the same model reading the same sources may be one signal, not two. C-CONTEXT can be SATISFIED while C-TEAM and C-WEIGHTS remain NOT-SATISFIED. Zheng's 85% vs 81% figure shows the same judge is stable, not that a second sample of it is independent. This unit's own two probes ran in the same vendor session on partitioned sources; that is not a cross-vendor review and is not claimed as one.

conditions.name: Different team with no overlapping personnel
conditions.literature_statement: ACM Results Reproduced and Results Replicated both require a person or team other than the authors. Raff §2 excluded papers whose authors had any significant relationship with the reproducer because intimate knowledge of communication style would bias results.
conditions.why_same_vendor: A fresh context window of the same vendor model is the same weights, the same training corpus, and the same vendor stack. That is one team identity, not two. 05-ECO anti-adoption #2 forbids treating a second same-vendor reviewer on the same input as independent.
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: Only a different vendor (different training run, different RLHF data, different tokenizer/runtime) can instantiate 'a person or team other than the authors' for an agent reproducer.

conditions.name: Different model family / vendor training corpus
conditions.literature_statement: ACM Results Replicated requires a different measuring system and independently developed artifacts. Zheng §4.2 Table 5 shows a single strong judge (GPT-4) is internally stable: 85% agreement with humans (S2, no-tie) vs 81% human-human. Stability is not independence: resampling the same judge is one instrument.
conditions.why_same_vendor: Same checkpoint + same decoding stack is the same measuring system. A new context does not create a new measuring system.
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: A different vendor's model is the agent analogue of ACM's 'different measuring system' / independently developed artifacts.

conditions.name: Independently developed artifacts (no author code)
conditions.literature_statement: Raff §1-2 defines independent reproducibility as reproducing results without using the paper's authors' code, and excluded any paper whose source was seen before success. Code Available was not significant (Table 1 p=0.213) for that independent outcome, while Authors Reply was (p=6.01e-8).
conditions.why_same_vendor: This estate reuses the same probe harness, Python, and catalog contract. A fresh context can write new scripts but typically inherits the same toolchain. That is ACM 'Reproduced' (same setup) at best, not 'Replicated' (independently developed artifacts).
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: Not uniquely cross-vendor: a same-vendor agent could in principle write a new stack. It usually does not, and this session did not.

conditions.name: Blind to the original conclusion
conditions.literature_statement: ADV-0005 / Phase 11 confirmation (catalog spec_anchor _USER-PROMPTS.md:11028-11041) requires the refuter receive source and question but not the answer, and plant false claims. Camerer 2018: replications follow analysis plans reviewed by original authors and pre-registered before the replications.
conditions.why_same_vendor: This unit's prompt includes the question, the expected sentinel shape, and the uncomfortable case to confront. Training data may also contain the cited papers' conclusions. That is not blindness.
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: Blindness is a protocol property, not a vendor property. A cross-vendor agent given the same unblinded prompt also fails it.

conditions.name: Independent data collection (new data, same question)
conditions.literature_statement: NASEM 2019 Summary: reproducibility = same input data, steps, code, and conditions; replicability = consistent results across studies that each obtained their own data.
conditions.why_same_vendor: Reading the same captured papers is NASEM reproducibility (same inputs), not replicability (new data). This unit did not collect new experimental data.
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: A cross-vendor agent reading the same sources also fails C-DATA.

conditions.name: No privileged author channel
conditions.literature_statement: Raff §3: authors of 50 papers contacted, 52% reply. 24 no-reply cases: 1 success (4.2%). 26 reply cases: 22 successes (84.6%). Most individually predictive attribute studied.
conditions.why_same_vendor: This session did not email original authors, so the Raff 'no-reply' channel is satisfied in the narrow sense. Weights may still encode author-like knowledge from training, so the condition is only PARTIAL.

conditions.name: Analysis plan fixed before seeing the outcome
conditions.literature_statement: Camerer 2018 abstract: replications follow analysis plans reviewed by original authors and pre-registered prior to the replications; sample sizes on average about five times the originals.
conditions.why_same_vendor: This unit generated the verdict in one pass after seeing the question. No pre-registered analysis plan exists.

conditions.name: Fresh context / no shared transcript of the original attempt
conditions.literature_statement: Estate Phase 11 / ADV-0005 treats a fresh context as the minimum for re-derivation. It is necessary and not sufficient. Zheng §4.2: the same model applies a stable internal rubric across items (GPT-4 S2 no-tie agreement with humans 85% vs human-human 81%).
conditions.why_same_vendor: A new context window with no prior transcript of this unit is real. It is the one structural condition a same-vendor fresh-context agent actually meets.
conditions.why_cross_vendor_only: Satisfiable by same-vendor; therefore not cross-vendor-only.

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: Author correspondence is the strongest measured predictor of independent reproduction success; absence of reply nearly kills independent success.

mechanisms.baseline: 1/24 successes when authors did not reply = 4.2% (50 papers contacted, 52% reply rate)

mechanisms.effect_size: R1D=0.24, R2D=0.25, R3D=0.26 (fraction of required variables documented); 0/325 empirical papers documented all variables
mechanisms.baseline: Complete documentation = 1.00 of required variables; boolean R1=R2=R3 fully true on 0 papers

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: Independent teams replicating with original materials still produce a large drop versus the original significant-result rate and a halved mean effect size. Team characteristics did not predict success as well as original-evidence strength.
mechanisms.baseline: 97% of original studies significant; original Mr=0.403 (SD=0.188); 39% subjectively rated as replicated

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: Even pre-registered, original-author-reviewed, ~5x-powered replications by independent labs recover the original claim only about three fifths of the time, with halved effects.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Camerer et al. 2018 abstract and main result (21 Nature/Science experiments, 2010-2015)
mechanisms.effect_size: 13/21 = 62% significant in the same direction; replication effects ~50% of original; complementary indicators 57-67%
mechanisms.baseline: 21/21 originals published as significant findings in Nature or Science; sample size ~5x original

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: A single strong LLM judge is a stable instrument (agreement with humans at or above human-human). Resampling the same model is not a second independent team.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Zheng et al. 2023 §4.2 High agreement between GPT-4 and humans; Table 5 S2 (w/o tie)
mechanisms.baseline: Human-human agreement 81% under the same S2 no-tie setup

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: This estate already forbids counting a second same-vendor reviewer on the same input as independence (05-ECO anti-adoption #2; ADV-0005: a same-vendor reviewer shares this unit's blind spots).
mechanisms.effect_size: Policy constraint (not a measured rate): second same-vendor reviewer on same input = disallowed
mechanisms.baseline: Required alternative: partitioned evidence and/or a different vendor
